name: setupguard
description: Tells you whether this repository is actually ready to develop in — and what is missing when it is not. Reads files, runs nothing.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: SetupGuard reads repository files and inspects the local machine. It never runs project scripts, package managers, build tools or containers, so opening an untrusted folder stays a read-only operation. The verification levels that would execute project code are not implemented; when they are, they will require a trusted workspace.

virtualWorkspaces.description: SetupGuard reads the workspace through the local filesystem.

scripts.package: pnpm run bundle && vsce package --no-dependencies --out setupguard-0.1.0.vsix
